# Test files

| File | Content | Built by |
|---|---|---|
| `modele_organisation.docx` | An organisation's Word template with placeholders | `tools/datasets/make_report_template.py` |
| `wash_bgd_2018.sav`, `wash_bgd_2018.dta` | 600 households, 13 columns, with variable and value labels from the questionnaire | `tools/datasets/make_stat_fixtures.py` |
| `wash_bgd_containers.xlsx` | 300 households and their 329 water containers (a Kobo repeat) | `tools/datasets/make_merge_fixture.py` |

Source of the survey data: REACH Initiative and UNICEF, Bangladesh WASH household surveys in camps, baseline and monsoon follow-up 2018, Humanitarian Data Exchange, CC BY 4.0. Values are unchanged; only rows and columns were selected.
